children: Signals are mixed for CBOT December wheat (WZ26), as it is consolidating within a wedge.

Trending signals will become clearer when the market gets out of the wedge. A break below $7.38-3/4 per bushel may trigger a fall into the $7.20-1/4 to $7.28-1/4 range, while a break above $7.60 could confirm a high-low bottom and a target of $7.81-3/4.

Immediate resistance is at $7.50-1/4, a break above could lead to a gain into the $7.55-1/4 to $7.60 range. On the daily chart, both the channel technique and candlestick pattern suggest a downside bias.
The three black crows between Sept. 2 and Sept. 4 represent a bearish market sentiment. The correction from $7.95 may consist of three waves. So far, only two have unfolded.
The downward wave c is yet to unfold toward $6.90-1/4, which is pointed by a rising channel, assuming the correction is the same degree as the one from $7.28-1/4.
